data.headline: Lead Technical Program Manager | Culture-Driven Tech Leader | Mentoring, Managing, & Making Magic in Games
data.about:
Story-teller, organizer, producer of games, experiences, and comics, writer, gamer, creator. 

Just a few of the things that describe and drive me. I am a dedicated team player and collaborator, with the ability to work between multiple teams from creative to technical to business-oriented. Throughout my life and career, I have always had a love for the intersection of creativity, experience, and technology.

Specialties: Project Management, Business Development, Asset Management, Team and Project Organization, Vendor Management, Budget Management, Communication, Collaboration, Client Management, Outreach, Pitch Presentations, Creative Contribution, Software Development, Relationship Management, Time Management, Agile methodologies- Lean and Scrum, Project Management Softwares: Jira, Trello, Asana, and Smartsheets, Unfailingly Positive Attitude, Quick Learning, Training, Leadership, Problem Solving

Feel free to connect and reach out.
	
Portfolio and resume available by request.

“We have to continually be jumping off cliffs and developing our wings on the way down.” 
― Kurt Vonnegut

description.text:
-Oversaw 18 student theatre and film productions through All Campus Theatre (ACT) as leadership board member, 6 months as PA on commercial and local film sets.

-5 years experience as director or assistant director for community and regional theatres.
-Managed technical and artistic teams, upkeep of group morale, working with teams to bring creative visions to life, casting, interpretation and dramaturgy of scripts, leading rehearsals, guiding actors and management team toward goals and strong performances.
-10 years experience in theatrical productions as assistant or lead stage manager, 3 years in events 
-Lead organizational force for rehearsals, meetings, and deadlines, support the cast and crew, create a bridge between the cast/crew and the creative leadership, run and call the performance cues, managing budget and profits, be the grounding force to the directors creative visions.
